reason: The quotes are free, but I don't have the money for a full system this month and every bit goes on generator fuel, so getting offers now just shows me prices I can't pay. When I'm closer I'll ask in the Facebook group first, because there people tell me who they used and what they really paid.
objection: Solar is simply too expensive for me right now, and I don't know these companies. A website asking for my appliances and my name feels like it will just bring sales calls for systems bigger than I can afford.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a small starter system (a few panels and one battery for lights, fans and a fridge) with a real price or monthly installments that comes in below what I spend on fuel each month, and people in my city's Facebook group saying they used SunXFinder and it was honest.
